import os
from google.cloud import aiplatform

def select_platform_resource():
    project = 'your-gcp-project'
    location = 'us-central1'
    model_name = 'your-model-name'
    model = aiplatform.Model(model_name=model_name, project=project, location=location)
    return model

import os
from google.cloud import aiplatform

def model_client():
    project = 'your-gcp-project'
    location = 'us-central1'
    aiplatform.init(project=project, location=location)
    return aiplatform

client = model_client()

import os
from google.cloud import translate_v2 as translate

def localized_platform_output(output, target_language):
    translate_client = translate.Client()
    result = translate_client.translate(output, target_language=target_language)
    return result['translatedText']

model = select_platform_resource()
for output in stream_platform_generation(model):
    translated_output = localized_platform_output(output, 'es')
    print(translated_output)

import os
from sentence_transformers import SentenceTransformer

def platform_output_embedding(output):
    model = SentenceTransformer('paraphrase-MiniLM-L6-v2')
    embedding = model.encode(output)
    return embedding

model = select_platform_resource()
for output in stream_platform_generation(model):
    embedding = platform_output_embedding(output)
    print(embedding)

import os
from gtts import gTTS

def platform_brief_audio(output):
    tts = gTTS(text=output, lang='en')
    tts.save('briefing.mp3')

model = select_platform_resource()
for output in stream_platform_generation(model):
    platform_brief_audio(output)
